{{External|rs|dw=Zombie Cow}} {{HasTask|Cows|Zombies}} {{Switch infobox |text1 = Normal |item1 = {{Infobox Monster |name = Undead cow |image = [[File:Undead cow.png|200px]] |release = [[15 February]] [[2005]] |update = Ghosts Ahoy and Slayer Update |members = Yes |combat = 2 |size = 2 |examine = It's an undead cow. |attributes = undead |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 1 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Crush]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 5 |slayxp = 8 |cat = Cows, Zombies |assignedby = turael,spria,mazchna |hitpoints = 8 |att = 1 |str = 1 |def = 1 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = -15 |strbns = -15 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = -21 |dslash = -21 |dcrush = -21 |dmagic = -21 |dlight = -21 |dstandard = -21 |dheavy = -21 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 50 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 2992 |leagueRegion = Morytania }} |text2 = Cutscene |item2 = {{Infobox NPC |name = Undead cow |image = [[File:Undead cow.png|200px]] |release = [[12 December]] [[2006]] |update = Animal Magnetism |level = 2 |members = Yes |race = Cow |quest = [[Animal Magnetism]] |location = [[Alice's Farm]] |options = None |examine = It's an undead cow. |map = No |id = 4421 |leagueRegion = Morytania }} }} '''Undead cows''' can be found west of [[Port Phasmatys]] in [[Morytania]] near the [[Farming]] [[allotment]]. As their name suggests, they are undead, so a [[salve amulet]] or a [[salve amulet (e)]] is effective to deal more melee damage. They can be killed for both cow and zombie slayer tasks. They respawn relatively quickly, so killing them may be an efficient way to complete unwanted slayer tasks. They are sometimes killed for their bones for the [[Ectofuntus]], most commonly during [[Ghosts Ahoy]] and [[Animal Magnetism]]. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Undead cow |location = [[Alice's farm]], west of the [[Ectofuntus]] |levels = 2 |members = yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:3611,y:3527|x:3616,y:3525|x:3620,y:3524|x:3622,y:3527 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Morytania }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== {{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}} ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Cowhide|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsLine|name=Raw beef (undead)|quantity=1|rarity=Always|gemw=No}} {{DropsLine|name=Bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Undead cow ribs|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes=Undead cow ribs are only dropped during [[Rag and Bone Man II]].|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} {{Reflist|group=d}} ==Dialogue== {{hastranscript|npc}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat |change = The NPC now has a 50% elemental weakness to [[fire spells]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 20 March 2007 |update = Cows, Chickens, Rabbits and the Fishing Trawler |change = The NPC was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 6 – 13 November 2006 |change = The NPC was renamed from "Undead Cow" to "Undead cow". }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Undead cow (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Undead cow.png|center|300x150px]] |- |15 February 2005 –
